grammar.summary: 本课学习 depend on 与 future 场景表达。

points.title: depend on/upon 表"取决于"
points.explanation: The answer depends on the weather. 表依赖/取决于，宾语可接从句 depend on whether...。

points.title: be to do 表安排的将来
points.explanation: The wedding is to take place on Sunday. be to do = 按计划将发生，正式语体。

examples.en: They are to be married next month.
